checks: Callables reject unauthenticated, malformed and oversized input
New association fences an older registration and another account cannot revoke it
Logout tombstone prevents delayed registration and legacy overwrite but allows a newer login
Logout removes owned pre-v2 rows without deleting another device or account
Partial transient response retries only the failed token and completion deduplicates replay
Expired processing lease recovers; active lease is busy and very old dispatch expires
An invalid-token response cannot delete the token newly associated with a different account
201 recipients preserve the first successful batch when the last recipient needs retry
A whole transport failure remains retryable and confirms only after recovery
Invalid legacy duplicates cannot overflow the transaction write limit
Both existing notification onCreate triggers enable platform retry
method: Compiled callable/dispatcher code, real Firestore emulator transactions and controlled FCM transport.
